oral_examination.oral_examination: 38 The left cheek was red and swollen near the mandibular angle, with low vertical impaction. Only 1/3 of the tooth crown was exposed. The surrounding gums were red and swollen, with deep blind pockets and pus overflowing.

treatment_plan.definitive: 38. Rinse the area and apply medicine and remove it as soon as possible after the inflammation is eliminated.

source_handle: 38. Alternate local flushing with hydrogen peroxide and normal saline, and iodine glycerin in a blind bag.
